Body.Content:
Microsoft Edge can now apply pending updates when your browser is idle. We've updated the Relaunch Notification policy to allow you to manage idle restarts for your organization.

More info: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/deployedge/microsoft-edge-policies/relaunchnotification

GA date: January CY2027
